events.text_en: The daughters of Hỏa Ti's reelers flee to Tang Điền with the reeling songs.
Hầu Tố Cẩm, a Tang Điền weaver, dies of the burns she took weaving fire into silk with her own Fire.
Tang Tục Lạc carries a strand of fire-silk reeled at the vent of Chúc Dung Khẩu to Chức Hà Các.
